title: Store each `GDType` member once and share it with subtypes by pointer
body:
## Introduction

This change builds on optimization work done by @Ivorforce in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/122751. It's a nice change, and now that all member types are stored in a unified hash map, it becomes easy to save further memory by allocating each member only once and storing only pointers in the `_members` map.

In the first version of this patch I had every `GDType::Member` allocated separately on the heap, but this of course caused cache misses which slowed down property access a little. To avoid this, I kept the memory packed by using a `PagedAllocator<GDType::Member, true, 1024>` (locking enabled because these types can be added from multiple threads, my measurements indicate it was still faster than doing separate `memnew` allocations).

I have tried to keep the patch focused on one thing, but due to the previous public exposure of the `AHashMap<StringName, Member>` storage there was a need to introduce some helper functions. At least all the necessary adjustments are very easy to review. That maybe should have gone into a separate commit and I can split it up on request. All the interesting bits are in `gdtype.h` and `gdtype.cpp`.

Disclosure: While I have taken great care to understand the approach and to test and review the code, I have relied on different AI models during development, both for finding this solution and doing the necessary API changes.

Measured on an editor build (Ryzen 9 3950X, GCC 16.2), against befe24c831:
- Static memory: 45.8 MB -> 32.0 MB (-30%). Process `VmData` drops by the same 13.8 MB.
- Member lookups: +0.5% instructions (callgrind), no measurable change in cycles or cache misses (`perf stat`).
- Type registration at startup (`--benchmark`, median of 20 runs): `[Scene] Register Types` 25.4 ms -> 21.6 ms.

I've posted the full benchmarks at https://gist.github.com/bjorn/a8f9aff7e40ca35ed6f9101459f83131

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Reduces static memory used by `GDType::Member` instances and speeds up type registration, while not meaningfully affecting access speed.

## Additional information

`GDType::Member` gained two members:

* `StringName name`: Since the `_self_members` of each class are now stored in a plain `LocalVector`, the names are no longer available from the keys of the `AHashMap`. Hence, when the own-members are iterated, their names now come from this member.

* `const GDType *owner`: Since the only remaining `AHashMap<StringName, const Member *>` used to look up members by name is the one storing all members (including inherited ones), this owner pointer was added to enable member-only lookup to return `nullptr` when the owner does not match the current type in `get_member`.

`GDType` gained one member:

* `LocalVector<const GDType *> _type_hierarchy`: This member is not strictly necessary in this PR, but it simplified the `MemberRange` type since this way it can iterate either own-members only or all members in hierarchy order (starting from the root type) using one unified implementation. The `members(bool p_no_inheritance)` function would otherwise need to return a type that can iterate either a `LocalVector` or an `AHashMap` (but I also plan a follow-up PR that actually speeds up member access and reduces static memory usage further, which replaces the `AHashMap`).
